jaloliddin.title: Jaloliddin Kadirov
jaloliddin.text: Chief Executive Officer – a manager with over 15 years of experience in leadership and executive positions in the banking and finance sector, specializing in small and medium-sized enterprise (SME) relations. Expert in corporate finance, risk monitoring, and strategic development.

jamoliddin.title: Jamoliddin Abdullaev
jamoliddin.text: Chief Risk Officer – an experienced specialist with 20 years of work in banking and finance, including senior management roles. Skilled in SME financing, operations, risk management, treasury, and financial planning in commercial and state banks.

mirzo.title: Mirzo Bozorov
mirzo.text: Chief Financial Officer – a leader with 10 years of experience in financial management, investments, and digital banking product implementation. Focuses on banking product efficiency and delivery channels. Holds an international ACCA/CFA certification.

mirgulom.title: Mirgulom Dosmuhammedov
mirgulom.text: Chief Accountant with over 15 years of experience in the banking and microfinance (MFO) sector of Uzbekistan. Deep expertise in accounting, tax reporting, financial control, and regulatory compliance.

about.heading: About IMPACT FINANCE Organization
about.subheading: Your trusted corporate partner on the path to a sustainable financial future and business growth
about.intro1: IMPACT FINANCE is a responsible microfinance organization in the Republic of Uzbekistan aimed at expanding financial inclusion, supporting small businesses, and ensuring economic stability.
about.intro2: We provide fair, transparent, and reliable financial solutions for small business owners, individual entrepreneurs, women, and individuals. Honest terms without hidden fees are our core principle.
about.missionTitle: Mission and Purpose of IMPACT FINANCE
about.regulatoryText: The organization's activities fully comply with the legislative requirements of the Central Bank of the Republic of Uzbekistan and financial stability norms.

values.trust: Reliability – long-term and responsible cooperation with every client.
values.transparency: Transparency – 100% clear conditions, zero hidden commissions, and transparent rates.
values.sustainability: Sustainability – supporting sustainable business growth for our clients.
values.collaboration: Client Care – an individual and prompt approach to every inquiry.

about.closing: For us, the success of every client is the success of IMPACT FINANCE.
about.nauforTitle: Member of the National Association of Financial Market Participants since August 13, 2026
about.nauforSub: Our organization fully complies with international and national standards for financial transparency, professional ethics, and client rights protection.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to the most important questions about obtaining a loan
faq.q1: What basic documents are required to get a loan?
faq.a1: Identity document (Passport/ID card), business certificate for entrepreneurs, and documents confirming income.
faq.q2: How long does it take to review an application?
faq.a2: Once a full set of documents is submitted, the application is reviewed within 15 minutes to 24 hours.
faq.q3: Is early repayment of the loan allowed?
faq.a3: Yes, you can repay the loan early at any time without any additional penalties or fees.
